name: Noel Elbe
source:
A soldier who looks after the protagonist.
For some reason, her rank is second lieutenant.
She's clumsy, slow, and completely useless.
She's constantly getting punched and kicked by the protagonist, but doesn't seem to get discouraged at all.

[Translated  from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20040202001505/http://www.cherrysoft.co.jp/cherrysoft/kyrie.htm]the official site[/url]]
